name: 1c_cc_charge_rest
description: Constant-current charge at 1C up to 4.2 V with no CV phase, then rest at zero current for 1 hour
comment: "protocol": "cc" charges at constant current and stops the moment the voltage reaches v_max, so there is no CV phase (the tester itself only offers CC-CV, so the software ends it). Then 1 hour of logged rest; change rest_after_s for longer or shorter. Use "cc_cv" for a full CC-CV charge instead. No cell is named: pick it when launching.
